subject: Application for Network Security Engineer | Immidiate Joiner | 3+ years exp
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to express my interest in any Technical Security Engineer or Network Security Engineer opportunities within your organization.

I have 3+ years of experience in network and security operations, including:

Check Point Firewalls
Palo Alto Firewalls
FortiGate Firewalls
VPN & NAT Configuration
AlgoSec (AFA & FireFlow)
SmartConsole
Firewall Policy Management
Network Security Monitoring & Troubleshooting

I have successfully completed my notice period and am currently available as an Immediate Joiner.

Please find my resume for your review:

Resume: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DRTxDOC5eIFGBuXq5tTnSY_irbby6fIn/view?usp=drivesdk

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss my profile and explore any suitable openings that match my skills and experience.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best Regards,

Mangesh Pandhare
